info.name: BiletFlow API
info.description:
End-to-end walkthrough of the BiletFlow backend. Run the folders in order, or use the Collection Runner.

Needs: the seeded admin and scanner accounts (SEED_DATA=true). Folder 9 also needs Mailpit (COMPOSE_PROFILES=mail, MAIL_ENABLED=true). Each run registers its own organizer and attendee, so it can be repeated.

item.name: 0 Accounts
item.description: Logs in the seeded admin and check-in staff, and registers a brand-new organizer, attendee and stranger, so the collection can be run again and again.

item.name: Become an organizer (returns a new token)
1 Event setup
item.description: Creates a published event with free and paid ticket types and assigns check-in staff.

item.name: 2 Paid-sales activation
item.description: NEW. Paid tickets are blocked until the whole checklist is done. Everything here is simulated; no money moves.

item.name: Paid ticket is refused before activation
Activating too early lists what is missing
Public event page shows paid sales are on
3 Buying tickets
item.description: Free orders confirm at once. Paid orders wait for the simulated payment, which can be declined on purpose.

item.name: Free order is confirmed at once

exec: pm.test("Name defaults to full name", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().attendeeName).to.eql("Dana Serikova"); });
pm.test("Name copied to the ticket", () => { pm.expect(ticket.attendeeName).to.eql("Әлия Нұрланова"); });

item.name: 3a Bank checkout (for PAYMENT_PROVIDER=halyk)
item.description: NEW. With the default simulator these just report provider SIMULATED. With Halyk: run folders 0-2, then this one (folder 3 needs the simulator). After "Open payment session", copy the whole response into postman/halyk-test-checkout.html, pay with a test card from Halyk's docs, then send "Ask the bank".

item.name: Order to pay through the bank
Ask the bank about this order
4 Ticket files and check-in
item.description: For the PDF, use "Send and Download" to save the file and open it.

request.description: Use Send and Download, then open the file. Try printing it and scanning the QR with a phone.

item.name: 5 Promo codes and Campaign QR
item.description: NEW. The server generates the code and calculates every discount.

request.description: Indigo with a frame, so it can't be mistaken for an admission QR.

item.name: Check the token from the QR link (public)
Quote: see the discount, reserves nothing
6 Notifications
item.description: NEW. The in-app list works even with email switched off.

item.name: 7 Support cases
item.description: NEW. Attendee cases go to the event's team; platform cases go to platform admins.

item.name: Attendee opens a case from a ticket

exec: pm.test("Server filled in the context", () => { const c = pm.response.json().supportCase; pm.expect(String(c.eventId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("eventId").toString()); pm.expect(String(c.orderId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderId").toString()); });

item.name: Organizer sees it in the inbox

exec: pm.test("Team name, no personal address", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().messages[1].authorName).to.eql("Event organizer team"); });

item.name: A stranger can't see the case
Staff moves it to in progress
Attendee writes again, which reopens it
8 Sales and moderation
item.description: Sales figures now include discounts. Admins can stop paid sales on one event.

item.name: 9 Account emails (needs Mailpit)
item.description: NEW. Skip this folder if email is off. It reads the emails from Mailpit, including the order confirmation with its PDF.

exec: pm.test("Email contains a link", () => { pm.expect(match !== null).to.be.true; });

item.name: The same link can't be used twice
Unknown address gets the same answer

exec: pm.test("Email contains a link", () => { pm.expect(match !== null).to.be.true; });

item.name: Order confirmation arrived with its PDF
10 Cancelling the event
item.description: Run last: tickets stop working and holders are told.

item.name: The ticket no longer admits anyone
Its PDF can no longer be printed
